answer: Sybil resistance arises because each bonded identity posts collateral in an escrow, while correlated equivocation across k identities triggers a quadratic aggregate penalty, O(k²), rather than k independent fines. Detection also applies asymmetric capital depreciation: a coordinated swarm’s recoverable stake is multiplied by an exponential loss factor, so adding aliases rapidly magnifies ruin risk. Thus marble, ferrous, and tundra accounts cannot cheaply diversify Byzantine control.
